en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a rural village scene at the edge of a dense conifer forest. In the foreground are fenced fields, a row of trees along a road, and several detached houses with steep gabled roofs and wooden facades. Hills covered with forest rise in the background. The caption "Oberbärenburg i. sächs. Erzgeb." appears at the bottom left, and the number "24837" is printed at the bottom right.
